transcript.text: When a microwave is 'not working' (no lights, no sound), it is usually due to one of three things: no power reaching the unit, a control lock being active, or a door safety switch preventing start. To narrow this down quickly, please check if the display screen lights up when plugged in. If it is completely dead, try plugging it into a different socket that you know works for another appliance.
yes the display is on, shows the time. it beeps when I press buttons but won't start

Since the display works and beeps, we know there is power reaching the control panel. The next most likely cause is that the microwave's safety system thinks the door isn't closed properly, even if it looks fine.

Since the display is working but it won't start, the microwave's safety system likely thinks the door isn't closed properly. Please unplug the unit first for safety. Then check the plastic hooks on the edge of the door and the slots they click into; ensure there is no food or grease blocking them and that the hooks aren't broken. Finally, try closing the door again to see if it engages firmly with a solid 'click'. Let me know what you find.
door looks fine and closes ok. theres a little L symbol on the display though

The 'L' symbol on the display almost probably means the Control Lock or Child Lock is active, which prevents the microwave from starting even if it beeps when you press buttons. This is a common safety feature to stop accidental starts. Please unplug the unit first for safety, then hold down the Stop/Clear button (or sometimes a dedicated Lock key) for about 3–5 seconds until the 'L' disappears and you hear a beep. If that clears the lock, plug it back in and try starting it with a cup of water.
ok held the stop button for 3 secs and the L has gone, it works now. thanks

That is excellent news. The 'L' symbol simply meant the control lock was active, which is a safety feature to prevent accidental operation. To avoid this happening again in future, just remember that holding the Stop/Clear button for a few seconds will toggle the lock on or off whenever you need it. If you have any other questions about your appliance, I am here to help.
